All research ↗

Systems / October 2026

Rethinking inference without NVLink

Measure the topology first. On PCIe-connected GPUs, a small collective can matter more than a faster matrix multiply.

Read the research ↗

Long context / October 2026

Making a million tokens usable

Long context is a capacity, communication and scheduling problem. We measure retrieval and latency together.

Read the research ↗

Deployment / October 29, 2026

Finding the useful throughput frontier

A faster batch is useful only while each user still gets an acceptable stream. We compare measured configurations at that boundary.

Read the research ↗

Agent reliability / October 2026

Correctness beyond a successful response

An HTTP 200 and valid JSON are not enough. Agent workloads need complete streams, correct tool arguments and faithful protocol behavior.

Read the research ↗

Serving / October 2026

A cache hit is not the end of the journey

Reusing computation only helps if the serving path also reuses the right state. Follow the bytes, not just the hit-rate dashboard.

Read the research ↗

Engineering method / October 2026

Every iteration should leave better evidence

Humans, agents and a shared knowledge base improve the system—and the way the next experiment is run.
